question: Are you open at 10pm tonight? I'm staying in Uluwatu.

answer.text: We are open until 11pm, so 10pm is within our hours. Our team will check if we can travel to Uluwatu and reply shortly.
answer.translation: Kami buka hingga pukul 23.00, jadi pukul 22.00 masih masuk jam kerja kami. Tim kami akan mengecek apakah kami dapat bepergian ke Uluwatu dan segera membalasnya.

professionalOnly.text: We offer only professional therapeutic massage.
professionalOnly.translation: Kami hanya menawarkan pijat terapi profesional.

callToAction.text: We bring our treatments to villas and hotels in Canggu, Pererenan, Seminyak, and Kerobokan.
callToAction.translation: Kami membawakan perawatan kami ke vila dan hotel di Canggu, Pererenan, Seminyak, dan Kerobokan.
